description: Read one indicator's code as the runner runs it: a chart built-in (ref builtin:ema20, builtin:vwap, builtin:rsi), a shared script (shared:<id>), one of your own (mine:<name>) or a house engine your plan opens (house:<name>); the answer names its author, the ON line (the market, bar size and window it is computed on), the series it reads, its inputs with their bounds and its source; code is open by default; a sealed one (its author paid to seal it, and the house's own readings) answers everything but the source, with the reason; free

market.description: the chart's market, such as BTC or NQ

params.description: the chart's dials for a built-in, such as {"emaA": 20}

tf.description: the chart's bar size, such as 5m

name: indicator_code
